verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is an API-first banking platform, so data can be pulled programmatically: you can list all accounts via the account endpoint, retrieve monthly statements, and query transfer objects. The docs also describe closing an account, with the remaining balance paid out by paper check. Nothing in the pack describes a bulk export or portability feature, and the statement format is not stated. missing for 10: documented bulk/full data export, explicit open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps), an offboarding/data-portability guide, independent corroboration.
